demo.title: Ferrow · Outdoor furniture in cast aluminium and teak

above.label: Ferrow · Outdoor furniture
above.heading: Furniture that _stays out._
above.text: Cast aluminium frames, plantation teak, powder coats tested through four winters on a Bristol roof. Every piece is made to be left outside.

above.label: From the trade
above.heading: “We put forty of them on a hotel roof in Lisbon. Three summers in, the teak has gone silver and not one weld has moved.”
above.text: Inês Carvalhal, head of interiors at a Lisbon hotel group

above.label: The warranty
above.heading: Twenty-five years on every frame, and a care guide for every season.
above.text: Teak is oiled or left to silver; aluminium needs a rinse in spring. That is all.
